name: Scheuermann Kyphosis
definition: Structural adolescent hyperkyphosis characterized by anterior vertebral wedging and endplate irregularity, usually affecting the thoracic or thoracolumbar spine.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis relies on clinical and standing radiographic assessment.
investigations.MRI: MRI for neurological symptoms or atypical features.
investigations.radiographs: Standing lateral radiographs show vertebral wedging and curve magnitude.

amber: Bracing may be used in skeletally immature progressive curves; severe deformity may require specialist surgical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vakra-prishtha/deformity phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Structural adolescent hyperkyphosis characterized by anterior vertebral wedging and endplate irregularity, usually affecting the thoracic or thoracolumbar spine.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
